programmes.d: A shaggy gold prospector boasts of striking it rich, then indulges in a spending spree, which he soon regrets.
A pretty young woman tries to leave an outlaw gang for a new life in Dodge City but is tricked into changing her mind.
A vengeful judge accuses Kitty and Festus of conspiracy in the killing of his son.
Fronted by a gun salesman, outlaws on a bank-robbing spree across the west head for Dodge City.
After robbing the bank, the outlaws kidnap Doc Adams and set fire to Dodge City to cover their getaway.
A boy's love for his guitar—all that is left from his late father's estate—leads to murder and a trail of trouble.
A gunman kills a young challenger and becomes a target for revenge—from his own son, as well as the victim's family.
Spaghetti western with Terrence Hill, Bud Spencer and black actor Woody Strode. Victims of oppressive town boss Honey are offered help by an unusual alliance of gunmen and circus performers. (Italy)
A gang steals a gigantic bar of gold and commandeers the Dodge City blacksmith shop in order to divide the loot.
An embittered ranch woman holds Matt Dillon and Kitty prisoner while plotting Matt's execution to avenge her husband's hanging.
Marshal Dillon is helped by a friendly young runaway who later faces him as a deadly adversary.
A respectable rancher and his son hang an innocent man and let a bewhiskered bounty hunter go on trial for the murder.
A farmer whose credit has run out gets a loan from Marshal Dillon and Festus Haggen, then loses the money in a poker game.
A rainmaker tries to end Dodge City's drought before a public well, the town's last source of water, runs dry.
A Scandinavian immigrant and his teenage son find the West even wilder than they had imagined when they settle in Dodge City.
To Marshal Matt Dillon and his deputies falls their grimmest task in many years -- the hanging of a ruthless gunman.
Kitty's conscience is torn between her sense of obligation to a man who saved her life and her concern for the law and Matt Dillon.
After eight years as a debt-plagued dirt farmer, a reformed outlaw rejoins his old gang to rob the Dodge City freight office.
Private detectives use Kitty and the daughter of an outlaw as lures to trap the girl's fugitive father.
Five nuns bring a wounded outlaw into Dodge City, then are reluctant to turn him in because he saved their lives.
A lovesick, broke transient embarks on a lucrative but perilous career-boiling nitroglycerine off dynamite for a gang of robbers.
Matt Dillon hunts a gang that has shattered one safe after another with nitroglycerine.
Kitty helps Marshal Matt Dillon switch identities with a killer in order to escape when they are kidnapped by outlaws.
